arecut: arek'ut — this then, so then; are 'this is' + cut 'then' written as one word
e: e — they; plural marker before a noun or verb · e — tooth, teeth; noun (also in we 'my teeth', re 'his teeth')
ꜭo: k'o — there is, exists; existential verb
ri: ri — the, that (definite article/relative marker, e.g. ri Tepew 'the Sovereign'); particle
vchuch: uchuch — its mother; u- 'its' + chuch 'mother', possessed noun
hunbaꜩ: Junb'atz' — Hunbatz; name of the elder son of Hunhunahpu; jun 'one' + b'atz', a day name (also 'thread, monkey'); kept as a name
hunchouen: Junchowen — Hunchouen; name of the second son of Hunhunahpu; jun 'one' + chowen, a day name; kept as a name
ta: ta — then, when, so that; particle introducing a following clause, also marks wishes/purpose · ta — hear, understand; transitive verb (xki ta 'they heard') · ta — after mawi, marks the negation (mawi utz ta chuxoq 'it is not good that it be'); particle
xul: xul — it arrived; x- completive + ul 'arrive'
xquic: xkik' — Xquic, the maiden's name; Brasseur takes it as the prefix x (ix), which makes a woman's name, + quic 'blood' or 'rubber' ('la Femme-Sang ou la Gomme-Noire'), inferred; kik' 'blood' is the known word; kept as a name
vbi: ub'i' — its name, called; u- 'its' + b'i' 'name', possessed noun
cut: k'ut — then, and so; narrative connective particle
ruꜭ: ruk' — with him/it; relational noun r- 'its/his' + uk' 'company'
oc: oq — yet, still; adverb of continuing state · ok — enter; verb (que rah oc pa hul 'they want to enter a hollow') · -oq — ending after a verb of motion marking the direction, written apart (apon oq 'arrive there')
ral: ral — her child, the child of a woman; r- 'her' + al; possessed noun (ral chupam 'her child inside her')
chupam: chupam — inside, within; chi + u- 'its' + pam 'inside' (the m spelling of chupan)
xa: xa — only, just, merely; particle · xa — you (did); x- completive + a- 'you', before a verb (xa riqo 'you found it'), the same letters as xa 'only'
zcaquin: skakin — a little (inferred); an adverb of amount
chic: chik — now, already, also; adverb of changed state · chik — any more (mawi xki nataj chik 'they no longer remembered'); in their turn, also
maui: mawi — not, no; negative particle, before a noun or verb
que: ke — thus, as; adverb of manner · ke — k- 'ongoing' + e 'they', before a verb (xa ke wachelajik 'they kept on screeching') · qe — for us (uncertain); qa- 'our, us' set (tzuqul qe, k'o'l qe) · ke — of them (banol ke 'maker of them'), compare kech · ke — k- 'ongoing' + e 'them', the object before a transitive verb (ke qa chak 'we defeat them', qa- 'we') · qe — us (the object after an agent noun, camol qe 'taker of us'); q- 'we, us' + e
yaqueic: yakeik — (guess) bearing, ways; not otherwise known, taken from its pairing with k'oje'ik 'being' (Brasseur 'coutumes')
hunahpu: Junajpu — Hunahpu; name, also a day in the calendar; meaning uncertain · Junajpu — also the name of a mountain (Brasseur: the Volcán de Fuego)
xbalanque: Xb'alanke — Xbalanque; name of the second of the two boys, with Hunahpu; make-up uncertain (Brasseur: x- diminutive + balam 'jaguar')
qui: ki — their; 3pl possessive/ergative prefix · ki — k- 'ongoing' + i- 'you (pl.)', written qui like the prefix 'their'; also k- + i(n) 'I' (inferred) · ki — fermented drink (inferred); noun, in qa ki 'our drink', after Brasseur · ki — how, so (inferred); a word of degree before utz 'good' · qi — truly (qi tzij 'truly'); written apart from tzij 'word', as qui ꜩih, after Brasseur's quitzih · ki — they (inferred); the person of the verb in qui caiih 'they look at it', as Brasseur reads it
bi: b'i' — name; noun, here 'their name' after ki 'their'
curi: k'uri — then, and so; k'u 'then' + ri, narrative connective
chire: chire — to him, to her; chi + r- 'him/her' + e · chire — at his teeth (inferred); chi + r- 'his' + e 'tooth' · chire — because, for; conjunction (chire lib'ajchi 'because quickly')
atit: atit — grandmother; noun (also in Ratit) · atit — old woman; noun
xꜭha: xch'a — said; x- completive + ch'a 'say', the singular of xech'a
mi: mi — now, just now; particle, as mi- in mixutzinik · mi — (inferred) do not, before a verb (mi xb'isonik 'do not grieve', after Brasseur 'ne vous affligez pas'); the form is not clear
vlic: ulik — arrived here; ul 'arrive here' + -ik, ending at the end of a clause
lal: lal — you; the respectful word for one person, used to a lord (with ajaw 'my lord'); pronoun
la: la — unexplained particle in kat kix la uloq; uncertain · la — you, Your Lordship, a respectful form (chi la 'to you'; inferred from Brasseur's note); particle
puch: puch — also, and; particle tagging the second of a pair
vloc: uloq — hither, this way; adverb with verbs of coming
apa: apa — where; interrogative adverb, asks the place
cat: kat — you (one) shall; k- 'shall' + at 'you', singular of kix · kat — you (one), of what is going on; k- 'ongoing' + at 'you' (kat b'e 'you are going') · kat — (inferred) then, so; taken as k'ut written cat (keje' kat 'so then', Brasseur quehecut), the letters respelled · k'at — burn; verb (xk'at 'it burned'), the root of k'atanalaj 'burning hot'; not kat 'you (one)'
vi: wi — there, here, in it; locative particle (points back to a place or time) · wi' — head, top (pa ki wi' 'on their heads') · wi — part of wikiq'ab' 'right (hand)' (inferred), written apart (vi qui cab, set against mox 'left')
chi: chi — at, in, to; preposition (also optative 'let' before a verb) · chik — again: chic with its final c shared with the next word (xki chi k'ut, xech'a chi k'u) · chi — with, of (chi ixim 'with maize'); also 'that' before a verb (chi qajaj 'that we carve') · chi' — mouth (ca chi 'our mouth', qui chi 'their mouths'); noun, same letters as the preposition · chi — ch- (command) + i- 'you (pl.)', before a verb · chik — any more (ꜭo chi vi 'is there any more'); chic with its c not written
pa: pa — in, at; preposition · pa — question particle after mi, 'has it…?' (mi pa xutzin 'has he finished?') · pa — after naqi, 'what (is it)?' (naqi pa); a particle of the question
val: wal — my child; w- 'my' + al; possessed noun
ma: ma — not, nor, or (in a question); negative/interrogative particle
xe: xe — they; x- completive + e 'they', before an intransitive verb (xe na'ojinik 'they pondered'); also xe' 'root' in the title line · xe' — the foot, the bottom of (a tree, a mountain, a ravine); xe' 'root, foot', before the noun
camic: kamik — died, dying; cam 'die' + -ic (xoh camic 'we died')
xibalba: Xib'alb'a — Xibalba; the world below, the realm of the lords of death, which the missionaries took for 'hell' (Brasseur's note); kept as a name · Xib'alb'a — the people of Xibalba, its lords and inhabitants together (xeꜭha Xibalba 'Xibalba said', ronohel Xibalba 'all Xibalba')
cu: k'u — then, so; narrative connective, variant of k'ut · ku — k- 'ongoing' + u- 'he', written cu like the particle (cu nimarizah rib 'he makes himself great')
caib: ka'ib' — two; numeral, ka'- with -ib' (the root of ukab' 'its second' and ukab'al 'the second')
ve: we — if, whether; conjunction · we — (uncertain) teeth, following Brasseur ('my teeth shine'), in nay pu ve raxcavacoh · we — yes; particle (Brasseur 'yes') · we — my teeth; w- 'my' + e 'tooth'
a: a — your, you (one person); a- 'your' before a noun, a- 'you' before a verb · a — (inferred) river, water; after Brasseur (chi quiqi-a 'at the river of blood')
vila: wila — look, see (command to you pl.); after chi (ch- + i- 'you (pl.)'): w-, the rest of iw- before a vowel, + il 'see' + -a · wila — I see it; v- 'I' + il 'see' + -a (vila na 'that I may see it first')
el: el — go out; verb (kat el 'you go out')
vbic: ub'ik — thither (inferred); an adverb of direction, with ok 'enter'
xuꜭhax: xuch'ax — he was told; x- completive + u- + ch'a 'say' + -x (passive), without its -ik
capoh: q'apoj — maiden, young woman; noun, written with plain c where Brasseur reads gapoh (his g is ꜫ); the q' is restored (inferred)
rumal: rumal — by, because of, through; relational noun r- 'its' + umal 'cause, agent'
xere: xere — just so, this is how, only this; adverb
nare: nare — (uncertain) meaning not known; Brasseur 'but you see'
rech: rech — of it, for it; relational noun with r- 'its' + ech
hunhunahpu: Junjunajpu — Hunhunahpu; name as written by Ximénez; elsewhere in the book the name of Hunahpu's father, here used of the boy Hunahpu (Brasseur notes the confusion) · Junjunajpu — Hunhunahpu, the father of Hunahpu and Xbalanque and brother of Wuqub' Junajpu; jun 'one' + Junajpu, a day name, 'One Hunahpu'
va: wa — this; demonstrative · wa — food, the maize tortilla (ca va 'our food', modern wa)
vcaam: uk'aam — carried by him, his carrying (inferred); u- + k'am 'take, carry' with the vowel written double; form inferred
ꜭazlic: k'aslik — alive, living; k'as 'live' + -lik, of one root with k'aslem 'life'
rib: rib' — itself; reflexive noun r- 'its' + ib' 'self'
zac: saq — white, light; adjective, root saq · saq — (inferred) white dice or knucklebones, in xa saq, xa chaaj 'only the white (dice), only play'; after Brasseur · saq — (inferred) make clear, speak out; saq 'white, clear' used as a verb (xki saq ki tzij 'they spoke their word out'), after Brasseur ('délivrèrent leur message')
xqui: xki — they (did it); x- completive + ki- 3pl ergative, prefix before a transitive verb · xki — you (pl.) (doubtful); in xqui zachic, xqui ca cup, as the parallel with quix camic requires; printed as written
bano: b'ano — do, make; b'an 'do, make' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb (xki b'ano 'they made it')
i: i — your (pl.); 2pl possessive prefix, as in i poy 'your effigies'
loc: lok — aimlessly, to no purpose (inferred); in xa lok
vvach: uwach — its face; u- 'its' + wach 'face, surface', possessed noun · uwach — its fruit (the face a tree shows); noun
xuꜭhaxic: xuch'axik — he was told; x- completive + u- + ch'a 'say' + -x- (passive) + -ik
ca: qa — we, our; qa- 'our' or 'we' before a verb · ka — (uncertain) in que ka k'o, 'there will yet be'; k- 'ongoing' + a · ka — k- 'ongoing' before a verb or state word, written apart (ka pichipoj '(they) are pichipoj', uncertain; ma ka jisaj, k- + a- 'you') · ka — second (inferred); kab' 'second' written without its b', as uka 'a second (pit)' · ka — (unclear) a particle before a verb or a word of state, left unrendered
pu: pu — also, and; short form of puch · pu — in, at (inferred); pa 'in', in pu chi' 'in the mouth' · pu — in its, in the; pa 'in' + u- 'its' contracted (Brasseur: pu for pa u, p'u 'dans le'), as pu b'eal 'by the road', pu wi' ja 'in the top of the house'
chaquih: chaqi'j — dry; adjective · chaqi'j — (inferred) dry (something), parch; used as a verb in xqui chaquih 'they dried it' over the fire (Brasseur 'jeté sur le feu')
vꜭux: Uk'u'x — its heart; u- 'its' + k'u'x 'heart, centre'; in Uk'u'x Kaj 'Heart of Sky'
chicut: chik'ut — again then, one more then; chik 'again' + k'ut 'then' written as one word, the c shared
hoxbal: joxb'al — (inferred) fornication, wantonness; jox 'lie with' + -bal (nu hoxbal 'my fornication'), after Brasseur ('déshonneur', 'crime'); noun
cha: cha — said, say; quotative root (uncertain in this phrase 'cha ta k'ut') · cha — at your; chi 'at' + a- 'your' (cha mox 'at your left', cha wi ki q'ab' 'at your right'), inferred · cha — (guess) arrow point, flint; after Brasseur's note (cha 'the word, the arrow, and the point of the arrow, obsidian or flint'), in xa kolokik cha 'only a round flint (?)' · cha — (inferred) blade, obsidian edge, as the arrow point above (chi cha 'of the blade') · cha — you (command); ch- + a- 'you' before a verb (cha coto 'you dig')
pam: pam — belly, womb, inside; noun (cha pam 'in your belly', ꜭo chi nu pam 'in my belly')
ꜭaxtoꜭ: k'axtok' — demon, deceiver; noun, the colonial word for the devil
cam: k'am — take; verb · kam — die; verb
biyh: b'iyj — say, tell; the verb b'ij 'say' with its letters in another order, as in xchicabyih
nu: nu — my; 1sg possessive · nu — I; ergative prefix before a verb (ka nu tao 'I hear it', ka nu riqo 'I find it')
bala: b'ala — unexplained (Brasseur 'at their ease'); uncertain · b'ala — here 'very well' after utz (Utz b'ala 'very well', after Brasseur 'C'est fort bien'); inferred · b'ala — (inferred) indeed; strengthens the word before it (qitzij b'ala 'truly indeed')
tao: tao — hear it; ta 'hear' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb (ka nu tao 'I hear it')
ha: ja' — water; noun · ja — house (modern ja; que rah acanic chuvi ha 'they want to climb on the house') · ja — go! (a command, inferred, after Brasseur)
cama: kama — taking, take (inferred); from k'am 'take', perhaps with a nominal ending; the toggle respells the letters
petic: petik — coming; pet 'come' + -ik, verbal noun (ki petik 'their coming', qui- 'their')
na: na — now, then; particle · na — still; particle · na — feeling, sense (inferred); na 'feel', the root of nao · na — (inferred) first, for the time being; as in oh na 'we first'
catepuch: k'atepuch — then also; cate 'then' + puch 'also' written as one word
xbec: xb'ek — he went; x- completive + b'e 'go' + -k
cumal: kumal — by them; r- 'by' form rumal with 3pl ki- · qumal — by us; r- 'by' form rumal with qa- 'we' (Brasseur kumal, his k is q)
xu: xu — it (did); x- completive + u- 'it', singular of xki
taqueh: taqej — (inferred) follow, keep on; taken as the taquen 'keep on, follow' of an earlier part, after Brasseur (takeh)
xopon: xopon — he arrived; x- completive + opon 'arrive'
xquiz: xk'is — it finished, they finished; x- completive + k'is 'end, be finished'
bixic: b'ixik — being said; b'ij 'say' + passive, paired with tzijoxik 'being told'
xcha: xcha — said; x- completive + cha 'say', the singular of xecha
chahal: chajal — guardian, keeper; agent noun from chaj 'guard'
tacal: takal — set, come to rest (inferred); said of alighting, striking, landing; sense inferred from the setting
re: re — of, belonging to; relational particle · re — his teeth; r- 'his' + e 'tooth'
vvi: uwi — her, in uwi ki q'ab' 'her right hand'; u- 'her' + wi, part of the word for the right hand (vi qui cab)
acan: aq'an — climb; verb (que rah acan 'they want to climb')
xpe: xpe — it came; x- completive + pe 'come'
xpetic: xpetik — (you) came; x- completive + pet 'come' + -ik, the person not marked
xbe: xb'e — he went; x- completive + b'e 'go'
ya: ya — give; verb (ku ya 'he gives') · ya — river, water (inferred, after Brasseur); noun, the letters respelled as written
vcoc: ukok — its going in (inferred, doubtful reading); taken with ok 'enter', the c not explained (Brasseur x-uq-oc) · ukok — its shell (guess), the false crab; u- 'its' + kok, perhaps 'shell' (Brasseur 'tortue')
xucut: xukut — side; noun, paired with tz'uk 'corner'
xoponic: xoponik — he arrived; x- completive + opon 'arrive' + -ik
xril: xril — he saw it, she saw it; x- completive + r- 'he, she' (the form before a vowel) + il 'see'
be: b'e — road, path; noun · b'e — go (chi b'e 'that we go'); verb, the root of xb'e 'he went'
chuxe: chuxe' — at the foot of; chu- (chi + u- 'its') + xe' 'root, foot'
retal: retal — its sign; r- 'its' + etal 'sign', possessed noun (xa retal 'only its sign')
vil: wil — I (shall) see it; w- 'I' + il 'see', in xchi wil na 'I shall see it'
